comment: Every user-visible string, once, for every shell. The core speaks codes; the shells speak these words. Tools/strings/strings.py writes the Apple String Catalog from it (strings.xml and .resw join with their shells). Keys are dotted lower case; an 'error.<code>' key is the words for a core error code. British spelling.

address.label.note: Accessibility label of the address field.

address.secure.note: Accessibility label of the padlock shown for an https page.

address.insecure.note: Accessibility label of the warning shown for an http page.

toolbar.open_location.note: Command (Command-L on a Mac): put the keyboard in the address field with the whole address selected.

tab.empty.title.note: Heading of a tab that has no page yet.

tab.empty.hint.en: Type an address or a search above.
tab.empty.hint.note: Hint under the heading of an empty tab.

error.title.note: Heading shown over a page that failed to load.

error.retry.note: Button on the failed-page view: reload.

error.net.offline.en: You’re not connected to the internet.

error.net.dns.en: The site’s address couldn’t be found.

error.net.connect.note: A load failed: connection refused or lost.

error.net.timeout.en: The site took too long to answer.

error.net.tls.en: A secure connection to the site couldn’t be made.
error.net.tls.note: A load failed: TLS or certificate problem.

error.net.failed.en: Something went wrong while loading the page.
error.net.failed.note: A load failed for a reason without words of its own.

error.page.renderer_gone.note: The process drawing the page died.

error.engine.no_profiles.en: The web engine on this device can’t keep each Space’s logins separate. Update Android System WebView and try again.
error.engine.no_profiles.note: Android: the System WebView is too old to give each login set a profile of its own.

error.engine.no_private.en: Private windows aren’t available on this device yet.
error.engine.no_private.note: The engine cannot make a login set that is kept in memory only.

error.engine.unavailable.note: The web engine the tab asked for is not installed.

catalogue.title.note: Title of the design catalogue: a screen for designers that shows every design token and every state of the window.

catalogue.colours.note: Design catalogue: heading of the colour tokens.

catalogue.space.note: Design catalogue: heading of the spacing tokens.

catalogue.radius.note: Design catalogue: heading of the corner-radius tokens.

catalogue.size.note: Design catalogue: heading of the size tokens.

catalogue.states.note: Design catalogue: heading of the browser window's states.

catalogue.state.empty.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.loading.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.secure.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.insecure.en: A page that is not secure
catalogue.state.insecure.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.long.en: An address too long for its field
catalogue.state.long.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.failed.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.state.history.note: Design catalogue: a state of the window.

catalogue.start_failed.note: Design catalogue: heading of what is shown instead of a window when the core refuses to start.

error.start.title.note: Heading when the core refused to start.

error.start.detail.note: Shown under the start failure heading. %@ is a code such as store.open.
